# basic/Int/u8

Basic calculator

## Index

| Operation          | Description
|--------------------|------------

## Operations

### add/u8

Adds *x* to *y*. Value wraps around on overflow.

Stack effects:
```
( x:Int/u8 x:Int/u8 -- x:Int/u8 )
```

Example:

| Input          | Stack
|----------------|------
| `255 1 add/u8` | `0`
